Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **November 3, 2025**, according to your own belated cutover recap (members/bettina-kroll/notes/2025-12-08-bettina-pellucid-cutover-recap.md).

That note also says you kept running PHL day to day until November 21, and Kwame fully took over the account on **November 22, 2025**. If the tracker needs one date, use November 3 for the official handoff and note November 22 as the day-to-day transfer.

I didn't find the date in Moss's Coastal digests. The coverage check from May 18 and the cheat sheet don't give it, so the recap is the source I'd cite.
